# Castells Media

Marketing agency for home service businesses in the United States. We build the
website, run the ads on Google, Meta and Yelp, set up the local profiles and the
follow-up, so the phone rings and no request is left unanswered.

Castells Media Inc, 1298 Antelope Creek Drive, Roseville, California.
Phone +1 (916) 619-6006. Email contact@castells.media.

## Prices

Published on the site, no call needed to hear them:

- Monthly plans from ${PRICES.monthlyOneChannel} for one channel, ${PRICES.monthlySeveralChannels} for several channels with local presence
- Websites from ${PRICES.websiteFrom} as a one-time project
- CRM and follow-up setup from ${PRICES.crmSetupFrom}
- Month to month, no contract
- The ad budget is billed by Google, Meta and Yelp directly to the client, and we take no cut of it

## What we do

- [Services and prices](https://www.castells.media/services): websites and branding, Google and Meta ads, local presence on Google and Yelp, automation and CRM
- [Prices](https://www.castells.media/pricing): the plans and one-time work in full
- [Our work](https://www.castells.media/work): named clients with live sites you can open
- [Industries](https://www.castells.media/industries): HVAC, plumbing, appliance repair, remodeling, automotive services
